progress.detail: Structural scanner over 26,608 .c files in s01 attack-surface dirs (kernel, fs, net, ipc, security, mm, block, io_uring, drivers, virt, lib, crypto); 129 candidate functions with >=2 user-fetches of the same pointer token; results persisted to agent-state/tmp/proj_001-i003-explore/doublefetch_scan.json.

Deeply read top ~20 clusters: usb devio, binder, io_uring, iov_iter, ipmi, sg, ext4, quota, nfsd cld pipe, pktgen, dvb_frontend, scc, ppp_generic, sbusfb, splice, utimes, ax25, sctp, n_gsm, genwqe, comedi, wwan.

drivers/usb/core/devio.c proc_submiturb() (and proc_submiturb_compat()): copy_from_user(&uurb, arg, sizeof(uurb)) fetches the whole struct incl. iso_frame_desc; proc_do_submiturb validates number_of_packets (1..128) on the kernel copy, but the iso_frame_desc pointer consumed by memdup_user(iso_frame_desc, isofrmlen) is RE-FETCHED from user memory via ((struct usbdevfs_urb __user *)arg)->iso_frame_desc. Same-location double fetch; validated copy != used pointer. Downstream memdup_user is access_ok-bounded so kernel OOB not demonstrated -> confidence low.
